The ionic-conductivity values at 25 ℃ calculated by equation 3 are listed in Table S2.

verdicts.explanation: The 2.44 mS·cm−1 value sits in the hybrid-electrolyte range that the paper explicitly reports at 25 ℃, so the null temperature is not right. The paper also never ties 2.44 to a specific UiO-66 loading, so the material attribution is ambiguous; under the strict rule this record is unsupported.
